title.zh: 卷九 本紀第九 懿宗 僖宗
title.raw: 卷九 本紀第九 懿宗 僖宗 Volume 9 Annals 9: Yizong, Xizong

meta.sourceNote: Body replaced from Wikisource raw text after ChineseNotes scrape due to glyph/encoding artifacts.

sentences.zh: __FORCETOC__懿宗懿宗昭聖恭惠孝皇帝諱漼，宣宗長子也。

translations.literal: __FORCETOC__Emperor Yizong, Emperor Yizong the Sagely Respectful and Gracious Filial, taboo name Cui, was the eldest son of Xuanzong.
translations.idiomatic: __FORCETOC__Emperor Yizong, posthumously honored as the Sagely Respectful and Gracious Filial, bore the taboo name Cui and was the eldest son of Xuanzong.

sentences.zh: 母曰元昭皇太后鼂氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Yuanzhao of the Chao clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Yuanzhao, née Chao.

sentences.zh: 始封鄆王。

translations.literal: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: He was first made Prince of Yan.

sentences.zh: 宣宗愛夔王滋，欲立為皇太子，而鄆王長，故久不決。

translations.literal: Xuanzong loved Prince of Kui Zi and wished to establish him as heir apparent, but the Prince of Yan was eldest, so for long there was no decision.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong favored Prince of Kui Zi and wished to make him heir apparent, but because the Prince of Yan was the eldest son the matter remained undecided for a long time.

sentences.zh: 大中十三年八月，宣宗疾大漸，以夔王屬內樞密使王歸長馬公儒、宣徽南院使王居方等。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the thirteenth year of Dazhong Xuanzong's illness became grave; he entrusted Prince of Kui to the Inner Pivot Commissioner Wang Guichang, Ma Gongru, the Southern Bureau Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat Wang Jufang, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the thirteenth year of Dazhong, as Xuanzong's illness grew critical, he entrusted Prince of Kui to Inner Pivot Commissioner Wang Guichang and Ma Gongru, Palace Secretariat Southern Bureau Commissioner Wang Jufang, and others.

sentences.zh: 而左神策護軍中尉王宗實、副使丌元實矯詔立鄆王為皇太子。

translations.literal: But the Left Divine Strategy Army protector-commander Wang Zongshi and vice commissioner Qi Yuanshi forged an edict establishing the Prince of Yan as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: However, Left Divine Strategy Army protector-commander Wang Zongshi and vice commissioner Qi Yuanshi forged an edict installing the Prince of Yan as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，即皇帝位于柩前。

translations.literal: On the day guisi he assumed the imperial throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he took the throne before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 王宗實殺王歸長、馬公儒、王居方。

translations.literal: Wang Zongshi killed Wang Guichang, Ma Gongru, and Wang Jufang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zongshi killed Wang Guichang, Ma Gongru, and Wang Jufang.

sentences.zh: 庚子，始聽政。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi he began to attend to government.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he began to hold court.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，令狐綯為司空。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Linghu Tao was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Linghu Tao was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 尊皇太后曰太皇太后。

translations.literal: The empress dowager was honored as grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager was elevated to grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，追尊母為皇太后。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day gengshen his mother was posthumously honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on gengshen his mother was posthumously honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 十月辛卯，大赦。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day xinmao there was a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on xinmao a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、勳、爵，耆老粟帛。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted ranks, honors, and titles; the elderly were given grain and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials received ranks, honors, and titles, and the elderly received grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，蕭鄴罷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day wuwu Xiao Ye was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on wuwu Xiao Ye was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎杜審權同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Du Shenquan was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Du Shenquan was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，令狐綯罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou Linghu Tao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Linghu Tao was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 荊南節度使白敏中為司徒，兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Jingnan military commissioner Bai Minzhong was made Minister of Works, and also Chancellery Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Jingnan military commissioner Bai Minzhong was made Minister of Works and also Chancellery Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 是歲，雲南蠻陷播州。

translations.literal: That year the Yunnan barbarians captured Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Yunnan tribes captured Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 咸通元年正月，浙東人仇甫反，安南經略使王式為浙江東道觀察使以討之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Xiantong the Zhedong man Qiu Fu rebelled; Annan pacification commissioner Wang Shi was made Zhejiang East Circuit observation commissioner to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Xiantong, Qiu Fu of Zhedong rebelled, and Annan pacification commissioner Wang Shi was appointed Zhejiang East Circuit observation commissioner to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，葬聖武獻文孝皇帝于貞陵。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day bingshen the Sagely Martial and Literary Filial Emperor was buried at Zhenling.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on bingshen the Sagely Martial and Literary Filial Emperor was interred at Zhenling.

sentences.zh: 五月，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the capital shook with an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 袁王紳薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Yuan Shen died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yuan Shen passed away.

sentences.zh: 七月，封叔𢗔為信王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month his uncle was enfeoffed as Prince of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: That year, eventh month his uncle was enfeoffed as Prince of Xin.

sentences.zh: 八月，衞王灌薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Prince of Wei Guan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Prince of Wei Guan passed away.

sentences.zh: 己卯，仇甫伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day jimao Qiu Fu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Qiu Fu was executed.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，白敏中為中書令。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day wushen Bai Minzhong was made Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on wushen Bai Minzhong was made Secretariat Director.

sentences.zh: 十月，安南都護李鄠克播州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Annan protector-general Li E recaptured Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Annan protector-general Li E retook Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，夏侯孜罷。

translations.literal: On the day jihai Xia Houzi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Xia Houzi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書、判度支畢諴為禮部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue and acting finance commissioner Bi Yan was made Minister of Rites and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue and acting finance commissioner Bi Yan was appointed Minister of Rites and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙亥，朝獻于太清宮。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on the day yihai he offered sacrifice at the Supreme Ultimate Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on yihai he offered sacrifice at the Supreme Ultimate Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，朝享于太廟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day bingzi he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on bingzi he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，有事于南郊，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou he performed the suburban rites, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the reign title.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he performed the suburban rites, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 是月，慶王沂薨。

translations.literal: That month Prince of Qing Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Prince of Qing Yi passed away.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，雲南蠻寇安南。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day wushen the Yunnan barbarians raided Annan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on wushen the Yunnan tribes raided Annan.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，福王綰為司空。

translations.literal: On the day haihai Prince of Fu Wan was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On haihai Prince of Fu Wan was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，白敏中罷。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year Bai Minzhong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year Bai Minzhong left office.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射、判度支杜悰兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat and acting finance commissioner Du Cong was also Chancellery Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat and acting finance commissioner Du Cong was also appointed Chancellery Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 福王綰薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Fu Wan died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Fu Wan passed away.

sentences.zh: 六月，鹽州刺史王寬為安南經略招討使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Yanzhou prefect Wang Kuan was made Annan pacification and suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yanzhou prefect Wang Kuan was appointed Annan pacification and suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月，雲南蠻寇邕州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Yunnan barbarians raided Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Yunnan tribes raided Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，寇巂州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month they raided Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That ninth month they raided Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 三年正月庚午，羣臣上尊號曰睿文明聖孝德皇帝。

translations.literal: In the third year in the first month on the day gengwu the officials presented the honorific Sagely Civil and Sagely Virtuous Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year in the first month on gengwu the officials presented the honorific Sagely Civil and Sagely Virtuous Emperor.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: There was a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 是月，蔣伸罷。

translations.literal: That month Jiang Shen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jiang Shen left office.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，杜悰為司空。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day gengzi Du Cong was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on gengzi Du Cong was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 是月，棣王惴薨。

translations.literal: That month Prince of Di Zhuan died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Prince of Di Zhuan passed away.

sentences.zh: 湖南觀察使蔡襲為安南經略招討使。

translations.literal: Hunan observation commissioner Cai Xi was made Annan pacification and suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan observation commissioner Cai Xi was appointed Annan pacification and suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，歸義軍節度使張義潮克涼州。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day wuyin Guiyi army military commissioner Zhang Yichao captured Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on wuyin Guiyi army military commissioner Zhang Yichao captured Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月，武寧軍亂，逐其節度使溫璋。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Wuning army mutinied and expelled its military commissioner Wen Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Wuning army mutinied and expelled its military commissioner Wen Zhang.

sentences.zh: 劍南西川節度使夏侯孜為尚書左僕射，兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Jiannan West Circuit military commissioner Xia Houzi was made Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat, and also Chancellery Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Jiannan West Circuit military commissioner Xia Houzi was appointed Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat and also Chancellery Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 九月，嶺南西道軍亂，逐其節度使蔡京。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Lingnan West Circuit army mutinied and expelled its military commissioner Cai Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Lingnan West Circuit army mutinied and expelled its military commissioner Cai Jing.

sentences.zh: 十月丙申，封子佾為魏王，侹涼王，佶蜀王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day bingshen his son You was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei, Ting as Prince of Liang, and Jie as Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on bingshen his son You was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei, Ting as Prince of Liang, and Jie as Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 杜悰為司徒。

translations.literal: Du Cong was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Du Cong was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十一月，封叔祖緝為蘄王，叔㥽榮王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month his great-uncle Ji was enfeoffed as Prince of Qi, and uncle Yi as Prince of Rong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month his great-uncle Ji was enfeoffed as Prince of Qi and his uncle Yi as Prince of Rong.

sentences.zh: 雲南蠻寇安南。

translations.literal: The Yunnan barbarians raided Annan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan tribes raided Annan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，降囚罪，免徐州秋稅。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin prisoners' sentences were reduced and Xuzhou autumn tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin prisoners' sentences were reduced and Xuzhou's autumn tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月，翼王繟薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Prince of Yi Chan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Prince of Yi Chan passed away.

sentences.zh: 四年正月戊辰，朝獻于太清宮。

translations.literal: In the fourth year in the first month on the day wuchen he offered sacrifice at the Supreme Ultimate Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year in the first month on wuchen he offered sacrifice at the Supreme Ultimate Palace.

sentences.zh: 己巳，朝享于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day jisi he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚午，有事于南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu he performed the suburban rites and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he performed the suburban rites and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 雲南蠻陷安南，蔡襲死之。

translations.literal: The Yunnan barbarians captured Annan and Cai Xi died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan tribes captured Annan and Cai Xi was killed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，撫王紘為司空。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen Prince of Fu Hong was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Prince of Fu Hong was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二月，拜十六陵。

translations.literal: In the second month he worshipped at the sixteen imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: That year, econd month he worshipped at the sixteen imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 秦州經略使高駢為安南經略招討使。

translations.literal: Qinzhou pacification commissioner Gao Pian was made Annan pacification and suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Qinzhou pacification commissioner Gao Pian was appointed Annan pacification and suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月，畢諴罷。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Bi Yan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Bi Yan left office.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎楊收同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day jisi Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Yang Shou was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on jisi Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Yang Shou was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊子，杜審權罷。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Du Shenquan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Du Shenquan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 閏六月，杜悰罷。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month Du Cong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month Du Cong left office.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎、判度支曹確同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Minister of War and acting finance commissioner Cao Que was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War and acting finance commissioner Cao Que was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月辛卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the seventh month, xinmao, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, xinmao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 免安南戶稅、丁錢二歲，弛廉州珠池禁。

translations.literal: Annan household tax and corvée levy were remitted for two years, and the pearl-pool ban at Lianzhou was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Annan household tax and corvée levy were remitted for two years, and the pearl-pool prohibition at Lianzhou was lifted.

sentences.zh: 八月，夔王滋薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Prince of Kui Zi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Prince of Kui Zi passed away.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，昭義軍亂，殺其節度使沈詢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day yiyou the Zhaoyi army mutinied and killed its military commissioner Shen Xun.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on yiyou the Zhaoyi army mutinied and killed its military commissioner Shen Xun.

sentences.zh: 五年正月丙午，雲南蠻寇巂州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year in the first month on the day bingwu the Yunnan barbarians raided Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year in the first month on bingwu the Yunnan tribes raided Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 三月，寇邕州。

translations.literal: In the third month they raided Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That third month they raided Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 四月，兵部侍郎、判戶部蕭寘同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Minister of War and acting revenue commissioner Xiao Zhi was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Minister of War and acting revenue commissioner Xiao Zhi was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，瘞邕、巂州死事者。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day dingyou those who died in service at Yong and Xizhou were buried.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on dingyou those who died in service at Yong and Xizhou were buried.

sentences.zh: 己亥，有彗星出于婁。

translations.literal: On the day jihai a comet appeared in the Lou asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai a comet appeared in the Lou asterism.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，夏侯孜為司空。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day dingmao Xia Houzi was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on dingmao Xia Houzi was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十月，貞陵隧陷。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the tunnel at Zhenling collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: That year, enth month the tunnel at Zhenling collapsed.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，夏侯孜罷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day wuxu Xia Houzi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on wuxu Xia Houzi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎路巖同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Lu Yan was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Lu Yan was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六年三月，蕭寘薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth year in the third month Xiao Zhi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year in the third month Xiao Zhi passed away.

sentences.zh: 四月，劍南東川節度使高璩為兵部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Jiannan East Circuit military commissioner Gao Cong was made Minister of War and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Jiannan East Circuit military commissioner Gao Cong was appointed Minister of War and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 五月，高駢及雲南蠻戰于邕州，敗之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Gao Pian fought the Yunnan barbarians at Yongzhou and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Gao Pian fought the Yunnan tribes at Yongzhou and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 六月，高璩薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Gao Cong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Gao Cong passed away.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫徐商為兵部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Xu Shang was made Minister of War and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Xu Shang was appointed Minister of War and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月，封子侃為郢王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month his son Kan was enfeoffed as Prince of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: That year, eventh month his son Kan was enfeoffed as Prince of Ying.

sentences.zh: 十二月，晉、絳二州地震。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Jin and Jiang prefectures were shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That year, welfth month Jin and Jiang prefectures were shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On the day renzi the grand empress dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the grand empress dowager died.

sentences.zh: 七年二月戊申，免河南府、同華陝虢四州一歲稅，湖南及桂邕容三管、岳州夏秋稅之半。

translations.literal: In the seventh year in the second month on the day wushen one year's tax of Henan prefecture and the four prefectures Tonghua, Shan, Guo was remitted; half the summer and autumn tax of Hunan and the three circuits Gui, Yong, Rong and Yuezhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year in the second month on wushen one year's tax of Henan prefecture and Tonghua, Shan, Guo, and the four prefectures was remitted, and half the summer and autumn tax of Hunan and the Gui, Yong, and Rong circuits and Yuezhou was remitted.

sentences.zh: 三月，成德軍節度使王紹懿卒，其兄子景崇自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the third month Chengde army military commissioner Wang Shaoyi died; his elder brother's son Jingchong declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Chengde army military commissioner Wang Shaoyi died, and his elder brother's son Jingchong declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 閏月，吐蕃寇邠、寧。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month the Tibetans raided Bin and Ning.
translations.idiomatic: That intercalary month the Tibetans raided Bin and Ning.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰，葬孝明太皇太后于景陵之園。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day jiachen the Filial and Bright Grand Empress Dowager was buried in the park of Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on jiachen the Filial and Bright Grand Empress Dowager was buried in the park of Jingling.

sentences.zh: 六月，魏博節度使何弘敬卒，其子全皥自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Weibo military commissioner He Hongjing died; his son Quanhao declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Weibo military commissioner He Hongjing died, and his son Quanhao declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，晝晦。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day xinmao the day was dim at noon.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on xinmao the sky darkened at noon.

sentences.zh: 十月壬申，楊收罷。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day renshen Yang Shou was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on renshen Yang Shou was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 是月，高駢克安南。

translations.literal: That month Gao Pian recaptured Annan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Gao Pian retook Annan.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，大赦，免咸通三年以前逋負，賜文武官階、勳、爵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day xinhai there was a general amnesty; arrears before the third year of Xiantong were remitted, and civil and military officials were granted ranks, honors, and titles.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on xinhai a general amnesty was proclaimed; arrears before the third year of Xiantong were remitted, and civil and military officials received ranks, honors, and titles.

sentences.zh: 八年正月丁未，河中府、晉絳二州地震。

translations.literal: In the eighth year in the first month on the day dingwei Hezhong prefecture and Jin and Jiang prefectures were shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year in the first month on dingwei Hezhong prefecture and Jin and Jiang prefectures were shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，以不豫降囚罪，出宮人五百，縱神策、五坊、飛龍鷹鷂，禁延慶、端午節獻女口。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day bingchen because of illness prisoners' sentences were reduced; five hundred palace women were released; divine strategy, five enclosures, flying dragon, hawk, and falcon birds were set free; tribute of women at the Yanqing and Dragon Boat festivals was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on bingchen, because of illness, prisoners' sentences were reduced, five hundred palace women were released, divine strategy, five enclosures, flying dragon, hawk, and falcon birds were set free, and tribute of women at the Yanqing and Dragon Boat festivals was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 七月，雨湯于下邳。

translations.literal: In the seventh month boiling rain fell at Xiapi.
translations.idiomatic: That year, eventh month boiling rain fell at Xiapi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，蘄王緝薨。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Prince of Qi Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Prince of Qi Ji died.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，懷州民亂，逐其刺史劉仁規。

translations.literal: On the day yisi the people of Huaizhou mutinied and expelled their prefect Liu Rengui.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the people of Huaizhou mutinied and expelled their prefect Liu Rengui.

sentences.zh: 甲子，兵部侍郎、諸道鹽鐵轉運使于琮同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi Minister of War and salt and iron transport commissioner for all circuits Yu Cong was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Minister of War and salt and iron transport commissioner for all circuits Yu Cong was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，疾愈，避正殿，賜民年七十而痼疾及軍士戰傷者帛。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day xinchou when his illness had healed he avoided the main hall and granted cloth to the people aged seventy with chronic illness and to soldiers wounded in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on xinchou, when his illness had healed, he avoided the main hall and granted cloth to people aged seventy with chronic illness and to soldiers wounded in battle.

sentences.zh: 十二月，信王𢗔薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Prince of Xin died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Prince of Xin passed away.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，有彗星出于婁、胃。

translations.literal: In the ninth year in the first month a comet appeared in the Lou and Wei asterisms.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year in the first month a comet appeared in the Lou and Wei asterisms.

sentences.zh: 七月，武寧軍節度糧料判官龐勛反于桂州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Wuning army grain-supply judge Pang Xun rebelled at Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Wuning army grain-supply judge Pang Xun rebelled at Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十月庚午，陷宿州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day gengwu he captured Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on gengwu he captured Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，陷徐州，觀察使崔彥曾死之。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou he captured Xuzhou and observation commissioner Cui Yanzeng died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he captured Xuzhou and observation commissioner Cui Yanzeng was killed.

sentences.zh: 十一月，陷濠州，刺史盧望回死之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he captured Haozhou and prefect Lu Wanghui died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he captured Haozhou and prefect Lu Wanghui was killed.

sentences.zh: 右金吾衞大將軍康承訓為徐泗行營兵馬都招討使，神武大將軍王晏權為北面招討使，羽林將軍戴可師為南面招討使。

translations.literal: Right Golden Guard general Kang Chengxiun was made overall suppression commissioner of the Xu-Si campaign army; Divine Martial grand general Wang Yanquan was made northern suppression commissioner; Forest Guard general Dai Keshi was made southern suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Right Golden Guard general Kang Chengxiun was appointed overall suppression commissioner of the Xu-Si campaign army; Divine Martial grand general Wang Yanquan was made northern suppression commissioner; and Forest Guard general Dai Keshi was made southern suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二月，龐勛陷和、滁二州，滁州刺史高錫望死之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Pang Xun captured He and Chu prefectures; Chu prefect Gao Xiwang died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Pang Xun captured He and Chu prefectures, and Chu prefect Gao Xiwang was killed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，戴可師及龐勛戰于都梁山，死之。

translations.literal: On the day renshen Dai Keshi fought Pang Xun at Duliang Hill and died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Dai Keshi fought Pang Xun at Duliang Hill and was killed.

sentences.zh: 是月，前天雄軍節度使馬舉為南面招討使，泰寧軍節度使曹翔為北面招討使。

translations.literal: That month former Tianxiong military commissioner Ma Ju was made southern suppression commissioner, and Taining military commissioner Cao Xiang was made northern suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That month former Tianxiong military commissioner Ma Ju was made southern suppression commissioner and Taining military commissioner Cao Xiang was made northern suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十年二月，殺驩州流人楊收。

translations.literal: In the tenth year in the second month the exiled man Yang Shou of Huanzhou was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year in the second month the exiled man Yang Shou of Huanzhou was executed.

sentences.zh: 三月，徙封侃為威王。

translations.literal: In the third month Kan was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That year, hird month Kan was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 四月，殺鎮南軍節度使嚴譔。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Zhennan military commissioner Yan Zhe was executed.
translations.idiomatic: That year, ourth month Zhennan military commissioner Yan Zhe was executed.

sentences.zh: 康承訓及龐勛戰于柳子，敗之。

translations.literal: Kang Chengxiun fought Pang Xun at Liuzi and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Chengxiun fought Pang Xun at Liuzi and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 六月，神策軍將軍宋威為西北面招討使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Divine Strategy army general Song Wei was made northwestern suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Divine Strategy army general Song Wei was made northwestern suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以蝗旱理囚。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu because of locusts and drought prisoners were tried.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu because of locusts and drought prisoners were tried.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，徐商罷。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Xu Shang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Xu Shang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士承旨、戶部侍郎劉瞻同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of Revenue Liu Zhan was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of Revenue Liu Zhan was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月，有彗星出于大陵。

translations.literal: In the eighth month a comet appeared in the Great Mound asterism.
translations.idiomatic: That year, ighth month a comet appeared in the Great Mound asterism.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，龐勛伏誅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day guiyou Pang Xun was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on guiyou Pang Xun was executed.

sentences.zh: 十月戊戌，免徐、宿、濠、泗四州三歲稅役。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day wuxu three years of tax and corvée of Xu, Su, Hao, and Si prefectures were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on wuxu three years of tax and corvée of Xu, Su, Hao, and Si prefectures were remitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，雲南蠻寇嘉州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day renzi the Yunnan barbarians raided Jiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on renzi the Yunnan tribes raided Jiazhou.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月甲寅，羣臣上尊號曰睿文英武明德至仁大聖廣孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year in the first month on the day jiayin the officials presented the honorific Sagely Literary, Martial, Virtuous, Benevolent, Sagely, and Broadly Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year in the first month on jiayin the officials presented the honorific Sagely Literary, Martial, Virtuous, Benevolent, Sagely, and Broadly Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: There was a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 雲南蠻寇黎、雅二州，及成都。

translations.literal: The Yunnan barbarians raided Li and Ya prefectures and Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan tribes raided Li and Ya prefectures and Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，劍南西川節度副使王建立及雲南蠻戰于城北，死之。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jiashen Jiannan West Circuit deputy military commissioner Wang Jianli fought the Yunnan barbarians north of the city and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jiashen Jiannan West Circuit deputy military commissioner Wang Jianli fought the Yunnan tribes north of the city and was killed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，劍南東川節度使顏慶復及雲南蠻戰于新都，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu Jiannan East Circuit military commissioner Yan Qingfu fought the Yunnan barbarians at Xindu and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Jiannan East Circuit military commissioner Yan Qingfu fought the Yunnan tribes at Xindu and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 三月，曹確罷。

translations.literal: In the third month Cao Que was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Cao Que left office.

sentences.zh: 四月丙午，翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎韋保衡同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day bingwu Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Wei Baoheng was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on bingwu Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Wei Baoheng was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月，殺醫待詔韓宗紹。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the medical attendant Han Zongshao was executed.
translations.idiomatic: That year, ighth month the medical attendant Han Zongshao was executed.

sentences.zh: 魏博軍亂，殺其節度使何全皥，其將韓君雄自稱留後。

translations.literal: The Weibo army mutinied and killed its military commissioner He Quanhao; his general Han Junxiong declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Weibo army mutinied and killed its military commissioner He Quanhao, and his general Han Junxiong declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，劉瞻罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingchen Liu Zhan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on bingchen Liu Zhan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，禮部尚書、判度支王鐸同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day xinhai Minister of Rites and acting finance commissioner Wang Duo was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on xinhai Minister of Rites and acting finance commissioner Wang Duo was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月癸卯，路巖罷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year in the fourth month on the day guimao Lu Yan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year in the fourth month on guimao Lu Yan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，理囚。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day gengshen prisoners were tried.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on gengshen prisoners were tried.

sentences.zh: 十月，兵部侍郎、諸道鹽鐵轉運使劉鄴為禮部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Minister of War and salt and iron transport commissioner for all circuits Liu Ye was made Minister of Rites and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Minister of War and salt and iron transport commissioner for all circuits Liu Ye was appointed Minister of Rites and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十三年二月丁巳，于琮罷。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year in the second month on the day dingsi Yu Cong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year in the second month on dingsi Yu Cong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 刑部侍郎、判戶部趙隱為戶部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Punishments and acting revenue commissioner Zhao Yin was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Punishments and acting revenue commissioner Zhao Yin was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 幽州盧龍軍節度使張允伸卒，其子簡會自稱留後。

translations.literal: Youzhou Lulong military commissioner Zhang Yunshen died; his son Jianhui declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou Lulong military commissioner Zhang Yunshen died, and his son Jianhui declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，平州刺史張公素逐簡會，自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day guiyou Pingzhou prefect Zhang Gongsu expelled Jianhui and declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on guiyou Pingzhou prefect Zhang Gongsu expelled Jianhui and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月庚子，浙江東西道地震。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day gengzi Zhejiang East and West circuits were shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on gengzi Zhejiang East and West circuits were shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 封子保為吉王，傑壽王，倚睦王。

translations.literal: His sons Bao was enfeoffed as Prince of Ji, Jie as Prince of Shou, and Yi as Prince of Mu.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Bao was enfeoffed as Prince of Ji, Jie as Prince of Shou, and Yi as Prince of Mu.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，殺國子司業韋殷裕。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day yihai Guozi Directorate vice director Wei Yinyu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on yihai Guozi Directorate vice director Wei Yinyu was executed.

sentences.zh: 十一月，王鐸為司徒，韋保衡為司空。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Wang Duo was made Minister of Works and Wei Baoheng was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Wang Duo was made Minister of Works and Wei Baoheng was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月，沙陀寇代北。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year in the first month the Shatuo raided northern Dai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year in the first month the Shatuo raided northern Dai.

sentences.zh: 三月，迎佛骨于鳳翔。

translations.literal: In the third month the Buddha's bone was welcomed from Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: That year, hird month the Buddha's bone was welcomed from Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，雨土。

translations.literal: On the day guisi earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi earth rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 四月，幷州民產子二頭四手。

translations.literal: In the fourth month a Bingzhou man bore a child with two heads and four hands.
translations.idiomatic: That year, ourth month a Bingzhou man bore a child with two heads and four hands.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day renyin there was a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 六月，不豫。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he fell ill.

sentences.zh: 王鐸罷。

translations.literal: Wang Duo was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Duo left office.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳，皇帝崩于咸寧殿，年四十一。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day xinsi the emperor died in the Hall of Universal Tranquility at age forty-one.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on xinsi the emperor died in the Hall of Universal Tranquility at the age of forty-one.

sentences.zh: 僖宗僖宗惠聖恭定孝皇帝諱儇，懿宗第五子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Xizong, Emperor Xizong the Gracious Sagely Respectful and Settled Filial, taboo name Xuan, was the fifth son of Yizong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xizong, posthumously honored as the Gracious Sagely Respectful and Settled Filial, bore the taboo name Xuan and was the fifth son of Yizong.

sentences.zh: 母曰惠安皇太后王氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Hui'an of the Wang clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Hui'an, née Wang.

sentences.zh: 始封普王，名儼。

translations.literal: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Pu under the name Yan.
translations.idiomatic: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Pu under the name Yan.

sentences.zh: 咸通十四年七月，懿宗疾大漸，左右神策護軍中尉劉行深、韓文約立普王為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourteenth year of Xiantong, when Yizong's illness became grave, the Left and Right Divine Strategy Army protector-commanders Liu Xingshen and Han Wenyue established Prince of Pu as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourteenth year of Xiantong, when Yizong's illness became critical, the Left and Right Divine Strategy Army protector-commanders Liu Xingshen and Han Wenyue installed Prince of Pu as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，即皇帝位于柩前。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi he assumed the imperial throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he took the throne before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，始聽政。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day guisi he began to attend to government.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on guisi he began to hold court.

sentences.zh: 丁未，追尊母為皇太后。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei his mother was posthumously honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei his mother was posthumously honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，韋保衡為司徒。

translations.literal: On the day yimao Wei Baoheng was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Wei Baoheng was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 九月，貶保衡為賀州刺史。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Baoheng was demoted to prefect of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: That year, inth month Baoheng was demoted to prefect of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 十月乙未，尚書左僕射蕭倣為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day yiwei Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat Xiao Fang was made Secretariat Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on yiwei Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat Xiao Fang was appointed Secretariat Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十二月，震電。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month there was thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: That year, welfth month there was thunder and lightning.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大赦，免水旱州縣租賦，罷貢鷹鶻。

translations.literal: On the day guimao there was a general amnesty; rent and tax of flood- and drought-stricken prefectures were remitted, and tribute of hawks and falcons was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao a general amnesty was proclaimed; rent and tax of flood- and drought-stricken prefectures were remitted, and tribute of hawks and falcons was stopped.

sentences.zh: 雲南蠻寇黎州。

translations.literal: The Yunnan barbarians raided Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan tribes raided Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 乾符元年二月甲午，葬昭聖恭惠孝皇帝于簡陵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianfu in the second month on the day jiawu the Sagely Respectful and Gracious Filial Emperor was buried at Jianling.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianfu in the second month on jiawu the Sagely Respectful and Gracious Filial Emperor was interred at Jianling.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，降死罪以下。

translations.literal: On the day guichou capital punishment and below was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou capital punishment and below was reduced.

sentences.zh: 趙隱罷。

translations.literal: Zhao Yin was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yin left office.

sentences.zh: 華州刺史裴坦為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Huazhou prefect Pei Tan was made Secretariat Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou prefect Pei Tan was appointed Secretariat Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 四月辛卯，以旱理囚。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day xinmao because of drought prisoners were tried.

translations.literal: On the day renwu Chao fled to Bashang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，復入于京師，弘夫、宗楚死之。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai he re-entered the capital; Hongfu and Zongchu died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he re-entered the capital, and Hongfu and Zongchu were killed.

sentences.zh: 是月，赦李國昌及其子克用以討黃巢。

translations.literal: That month Li Guochang and his son Keyong were amnestied to attack Huang Chao.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Guochang and his son Keyong were amnestied to attack Huang Chao.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，克用寇太原，振武軍節度使契苾璋敗之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day bingchen Keyong raided Taiyuan and Zhenwu military commissioner Qibi Zhang defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on bingchen Keyong raided Taiyuan and Zhenwu military commissioner Qibi Zhang defeated him.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大風，雨土。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou a great wind blew and earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou a great wind blew and earth rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉巨容為南面行營招討使。

translations.literal: That month Liu Jurong was made southern campaign suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Jurong was made southern campaign suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 楊復光克鄧州。

translations.literal: Yang Fuguang recaptured Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fuguang retook Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，鄮賊鍾季文陷明州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Yin bandit Zhong Jiwen captured Mingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Yin bandit Zhong Jiwen took Mingzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，邠寧節度副使朱玫及黃巢戰于興平，敗績。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day xinmao Bingning deputy military commissioner Zhu Mei fought Huang Chao at Xingping and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on xinmao Bingning deputy military commissioner Zhu Mei fought Huang Chao at Xingping and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，鄭畋為司空，兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事、京城四面行營都統。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu Zheng Tian was made Minister of Works, and also Chancellery Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and overall commander of the four sides of the capital campaign army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zheng Tian was made Minister of Works and also Chancellery Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and overall commander of the four sides of the capital campaign army.

sentences.zh: 丙午，李克用陷忻、代二州。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu Li Keyong captured Xin and Dai prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Li Keyong captured Xin and Dai prefectures.

sentences.zh: 七月丁巳，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day dingsi there was a general amnesty and the reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on dingsi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title was changed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎韋昭度同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Wei Zhaodu was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Wei Zhaodu was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，神策軍將郭琪反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin Divine Strategy army general Guo Qi rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Divine Strategy army general Guo Qi rebelled and was executed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，田令孜殺左拾遺孟昭圖。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Tian Lingzi killed Left Reminder Meng Zhaotu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Tian Lingzi killed Left Reminder Meng Zhaotu.

sentences.zh: 義武軍節度使王處存為東南面行營招討使。

translations.literal: Yiwu military commissioner Wang Chucun was made southeastern campaign suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yiwu military commissioner Wang Chucun was made southeastern campaign suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月，感化軍將時溥逐其節度使支詳，自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Ganhua army general Shi Pu expelled its military commissioner Zhi Xiang and declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Ganhua army general Shi Pu expelled its military commissioner Zhi Xiang and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 昭義軍節度使高潯及黃巢戰于石橋，敗績，十將成麟殺潯，入于潞州。

translations.literal: Zhaoyi military commissioner Gao Xun fought Huang Chao at Stone Bridge and was defeated; the ten commanders' Cheng Lin killed Xun and entered Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoyi military commissioner Gao Xun fought Huang Chao at Stone Bridge and was defeated; commander Cheng Lin killed Xun and entered Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，眾星隕于成都。

translations.literal: On the day jichou many stars fell at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou many stars fell at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，鄜延節度使李孝章、夏綏銀節度使拓拔思恭及黃巢戰于東渭橋，敗績。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingwu Yanxi military commissioner Li Xiaozhang and Xia-Sui-Yin military commissioner Tuoba Sichong fought Huang Chao at East Wei Bridge and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on bingwu Yanxi military commissioner Li Xiaozhang and Xia-Sui-Yin military commissioner Tuoba Sichong fought Huang Chao at East Wei Bridge and were defeated.

sentences.zh: 臨海賊杜雄陷台州。

translations.literal: The Linhai bandit Du Xiong captured Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Linhai bandit Du Xiong took Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，封子震為建王。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou his son Zhen was enfeoffed as Prince of Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou his son Zhen was enfeoffed as Prince of Jian.

sentences.zh: 己巳，昭義軍戍將孟方立殺成麟，自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Zhaoyi garrison general Meng Fangli killed Cheng Lin and declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zhaoyi garrison general Meng Fangli killed Cheng Lin and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 永嘉賊朱褒陷溫州。

translations.literal: The Yongjia bandit Zhu Bao captured Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongjia bandit Zhu Bao took Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 是秋，河東霜殺禾。

translations.literal: That autumn frost in Hedong killed the grain.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn frost in Hedong killed the grain.

sentences.zh: 十月，鳳翔行軍司馬李昌言逐其節度使鄭畋。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Fengxiang campaign marshal Li Changyan expelled its military commissioner Zheng Tian.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Fengxiang campaign marshal Li Changyan expelled its military commissioner Zheng Tian.

sentences.zh: 十一月，李昌言為鳳翔節度行營招討使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Li Changyan was made Fengxiang circuit campaign suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Li Changyan was made Fengxiang circuit campaign suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 鄭畋、裴澈罷。

translations.literal: Zheng Tian and Pei Che were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Tian and Pei Che were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 遂昌賊盧約陷處州。

translations.literal: The Suichang bandit Lu Yue captured Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Suichang bandit Lu Yue took Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，安南戍將閔頊逐湖南觀察使李裕，自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Annan garrison general Min Xu expelled Hunan observation commissioner Li Yu and declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Annan garrison general Min Xu expelled Hunan observation commissioner Li Yu and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是歲，霍丘鎮使王緒陷壽、光二州。

translations.literal: That year Huoqiu garrison commander Wang Xu captured Shou and Guang prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That year Huoqiu garrison commander Wang Xu took Shou and Guang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 二年正月辛亥，王鐸為諸道行營都都統，承制封拜，太子少師崔安潛副之。

translations.literal: In the second year in the first month on the day xinhai Wang Duo was made overall commander of all circuit campaign armies with authority to enfeoff and appoint; heir apparent tutor Cui Anqian was his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year in the first month on xinhai Wang Duo was made overall commander of all circuit campaign armies with authority to enfeoff and appoint, and heir apparent tutor Cui Anqian was his deputy.

sentences.zh: 高駢罷都統。

translations.literal: Gao Pian was dismissed as overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Pian was dismissed as overall commander.

sentences.zh: 辛未，王處存為京城東面都統，李孝章為北面都統，拓拔思恭為南面都統。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Wang Chucun was made eastern overall commander of the capital; Li Xiaozhang was made northern overall commander; Tuoba Sichong was made southern overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Wang Chucun was made eastern overall commander of the capital, Li Xiaozhang was made northern overall commander, and Tuoba Sichong was made southern overall commander.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，黃巢陷同州。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jiaxu Huang Chao captured Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jiaxu Huang Chao captured Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太子少傅分司東都鄭畋為司空，兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jimao former eastern capital branch tutor Zheng Tian was made Minister of Works, and also Chancellery Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao former eastern capital branch tutor Zheng Tian was made Minister of Works and also Chancellery Vice Minister and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，李昌言為京城西面都統，邠寧節度使朱玫為河南都統、諸谷防遏使。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Li Changyan was made western overall commander of the capital; Bingning military commissioner Zhu Mei was made Henan overall commander and barrier commissioner of all passes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Changyan was made western overall commander of the capital, and Bingning military commissioner Zhu Mei was made Henan overall commander and barrier commissioner of all passes.

sentences.zh: 三月，邛州蠻阡能叛，西川部將楊行遷討之。

translations.literal: In the third month the Qiongzhou barbarian Qian Neng rebelled; West Sichuan subordinate general Yang Xingqian was sent to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Qiongzhou barbarian Qian Neng rebelled, and West Sichuan subordinate general Yang Xingqian was sent to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 李克用陷蔚州。

translations.literal: Li Keyong captured Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong took Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，朱玫為京城西北面行營都統。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Zhu Mei was made northwestern overall commander of the capital campaign army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Zhu Mei was made northwestern overall commander of the capital campaign army.

sentences.zh: 楊行遷及阡能戰于乾溪，敗績。

translations.literal: Yang Xingqian fought Qian Neng at Qianxi and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingqian fought Qian Neng at Qianxi and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 己亥，荊南監軍朱敬玫殺其節度使段彥謩，少尹李燧自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day jihai Jingnan army supervisor Zhu Jingmei killed its military commissioner Duan Yanmo; junior prefect Li Sui declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Jingnan army supervisor Zhu Jingmei killed its military commissioner Duan Yanmo, and junior prefect Li Sui declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七月，保大軍節度留後東方逵為京城東面行營招討使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Baoda army acting commissioner Dongfang Kui was made eastern capital campaign suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Baoda army acting commissioner Dongfang Kui was made eastern capital campaign suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 撫州刺史鍾傳陷洪州，江西觀察使高茂卿奔于江州。

translations.literal: Fuzhou prefect Zhong Chuan captured Hongzhou; Jiangxi observation commissioner Gao Maoqing fled to Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou prefect Zhong Chuan captured Hongzhou, and Jiangxi observation commissioner Gao Maoqing fled to Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，東方逵為京城東北面行營都統，拓拔思恭為京城四面都統。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day dingsi Dongfang Kui was made northeastern overall commander of the capital campaign army; Tuoba Sichong was made overall commander of the four sides of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on dingsi Dongfang Kui was made northeastern overall commander of the capital campaign army, and Tuoba Sichong was made overall commander of the four sides of the capital.

sentences.zh: 魏博節度使韓簡陷孟州。

translations.literal: Weibo military commissioner Han Jian captured Mengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Weibo military commissioner Han Jian took Mengzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌，黃巢將朱溫以同州降。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingxu Huang Chao's general Zhu Wen surrendered Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on bingxu Huang Chao's general Zhu Wen surrendered Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，溫為右金吾衞大將軍、河中行營招討副使。

translations.literal: On the day jihai Wen was made Right Golden Guard grand general and Heyang campaign deputy suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Wen was made Right Golden Guard grand general and Heyang campaign deputy suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，太原桃李實。

translations.literal: That month peach and plum bore fruit at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month peach and plum bore fruit at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 嶺南西道軍亂，逐其節度使張從訓。

translations.literal: The Lingnan West Circuit army mutinied and expelled its military commissioner Zhang Congxun.
translations.idiomatic: The Lingnan West Circuit army mutinied and expelled its military commissioner Zhang Congxun.

sentences.zh: 平盧軍將王敬武逐其節度使安師儒，自稱留後。

translations.literal: Pinglu army general Wang Jingwu expelled its military commissioner An Shiru and declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Pinglu army general Wang Jingwu expelled its military commissioner An Shiru and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十月，嵐州刺史湯羣以沙陀反。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Lanzhou prefect Tang Qun rebelled with the Shatuo.
translations.idiomatic: That year, enth month Lanzhou prefect Tang Qun rebelled with the Shatuo.

sentences.zh: 韓簡寇鄆州，天平軍節度使曹全晸死之，部將崔用自稱留後。

translations.literal: Han Jian raided Yanzhou; Tianping military commissioner Cao Quanzhen died in the fighting; his subordinate Cui Yong declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian raided Yanzhou; Tianping military commissioner Cao Quanzhen was killed, and his subordinate Cui Yong declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 諸葛爽陷孟州。

translations.literal: Zhuge Shuang captured Mengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuge Shuang took Mengzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月，荊南軍亂，衙將陳儒自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Jingnan army mutinied; yamen officer Chen Ru declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Jingnan army mutinied, and yamen officer Chen Ru declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙子，湯羣伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi Tang Qun was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Tang Qun was executed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，關中大饑。

translations.literal: That year Guanzhong suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year Guanzhong suffered great famine.

sentences.zh: 南城賊危全諷陷撫州。

translations.literal: The Nancheng bandit Wei Quanfeng captured Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Nancheng bandit Wei Quanfeng took Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 危仔倡陷信州。

translations.literal: Wei Zichang captured Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zichang took Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 廬州將楊行密逐其刺史郎幼復。

translations.literal: Luzhou general Yang Xingmi expelled its prefect Lang Youfu.
translations.idiomatic: Luzhou general Yang Xingmi expelled its prefect Lang Youfu.

sentences.zh: 和州刺史秦彥逐宣歙觀察使竇潏。

translations.literal: Hezhou prefect Qin Yan expelled Xuanchen observation commissioner Dou Run.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhou prefect Qin Yan expelled Xuanchen observation commissioner Dou Run.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，雁門節度使李克用為京城東北面行營都統。

translations.literal: In the third year in the first month Yanmen military commissioner Li Keyong was made northeastern overall commander of the capital campaign army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year in the first month Yanmen military commissioner Li Keyong was made northeastern overall commander of the capital campaign army.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，王鐸罷。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Wang Duo was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Wang Duo was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 二月，魏博軍亂，殺其節度使韓簡，其將樂彥禎自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the second month the Weibo army mutinied and killed its military commissioner Han Jian; his general Yue Yanzhen declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Weibo army mutinied and killed its military commissioner Han Jian, and his general Yue Yanzhen declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己未，建王震為太保。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei Prince of Jian Zhen was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Prince of Jian Zhen was made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 三月，天有聲于浙西。

translations.literal: In the third month heaven made a sound in Zhexi.
translations.idiomatic: That year, hird month heaven made a sound in Zhexi.

sentences.zh: 壬申，李克用及黃巢戰于零口，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day renshen Li Keyong fought Huang Chao at Lingkou and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Li Keyong fought Huang Chao at Lingkou and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 四月甲辰，又敗之于渭南。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day jiachen he again defeated him at Weinan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jiachen he again defeated him at Weinan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復京師。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu the capital was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the capital was recovered.

sentences.zh: 五月，鄭畋為司徒，東都留守、檢校司空鄭從讜為司空：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Zheng Tian was made Minister of Works; eastern capital defender and Acting Minister of Works Zheng Congdang was made Minister of Works: Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Zheng Tian was made Minister of Works; eastern capital defender and Acting Minister of Works Zheng Congdang was made Minister of Works and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 淮南將張瓌陷復州。

translations.literal: Huainan general Zhang Gui captured Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan general Zhang Gui took Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 奉國軍節度使秦宗權叛附于黃巢。

translations.literal: Fengguo military commissioner Qin Zongquan rebelled and submitted to Huang Chao.
translations.idiomatic: Fengguo military commissioner Qin Zongquan rebelled and submitted to Huang Chao.

sentences.zh: 七月，宣武軍節度副大使朱全忠為東北面都招討使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Xuanwu deputy military commissioner Zhu Quanzhong was made northeastern overall suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Xuanwu deputy military commissioner Zhu Quanzhong was made northeastern overall suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 鄭畋罷。

translations.literal: Zheng Tian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Tian left office.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書、判度支裴澈同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Minister of War and acting finance commissioner Pei Che was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War and acting finance commissioner Pei Che was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月，黃巢、秦宗權寇陳州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Huang Chao and Qin Zongquan raided Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That eighth month Huang Chao and Qin Zongquan raided Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 淮南將韓師德陷岳州。

translations.literal: Huainan general Han Shide captured Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan general Han Shide took Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，武寧軍節度使時溥為東面兵馬都統。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Wuning military commissioner Shi Pu was made eastern overall troop commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Wuning military commissioner Shi Pu was made eastern overall troop commander.

sentences.zh: 是秋，晉州地震。

translations.literal: That autumn Jinzhou was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Jinzhou was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十月，全椒賊許勍陷滁州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Quanjiao bandit Xu Qin captured Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Quanjiao bandit Xu Qin took Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 李克用陷潞州，刺史李殷銳死之。

translations.literal: Li Keyong captured Luzhou and prefect Li Yinrui died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong captured Luzhou and prefect Li Yinrui was killed.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，劍南西川行軍司馬高仁厚及阡能戰于邛州，敗之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day renshen Jiannan West Circuit campaign marshal Gao Renhou fought Qian Neng at Qiongzhou and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renshen Jiannan West Circuit campaign marshal Gao Renhou fought Qian Neng at Qiongzhou and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 十二月，忠武軍將鹿晏弘逐興元節度使牛勗，自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Zhongwu army general Lu Yanhong expelled Xingyuan military commissioner Niu Xu and declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Zhongwu army general Lu Yanhong expelled Xingyuan military commissioner Niu Xu and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天平軍將曹存實克鄆州。

translations.literal: That year Tianping army general Cao Cunshi captured Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tianping army general Cao Cunshi captured Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 石鏡鎮將董昌逐杭州刺史路審中。

translations.literal: Shijing garrison commander Dong Chang expelled Hangzhou prefect Lu Shenzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Shijing garrison commander Dong Chang expelled Hangzhou prefect Lu Shenzhong.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，婺州將王鎮執其刺史黃碣，叛附于董昌。

translations.literal: In the fourth year in the first month the Wuzhou general Wang Zhen seized its prefect Huang E and rebelled in submission to Dong Chang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year in the first month the Wuzhou general Wang Zhen seized its prefect Huang E and rebelled in submission to Dong Chang.

sentences.zh: 二月，鎮伏誅。

translations.literal: In the second month Zhen was executed.
translations.idiomatic: That year, econd month Zhen was executed.

sentences.zh: 浦陽將蔣瓌陷婺州。

translations.literal: The Puyang general Jiang Gui captured Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Puyang general Jiang Gui took Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，陷孟州，河陽將李罕之入于孟州，張全義入于東都。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he captured Mengzhou; Heyang general Li Hanzhi entered Mengzhou and Zhang Quanyi entered the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he took Mengzhou; Heyang general Li Hanzhi entered Mengzhou and Zhang Quanyi entered the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 己酉，鳳翔節度使李昌符反。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou Fengxiang military commissioner Li Changfu rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Fengxiang military commissioner Li Changfu rebelled.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，犯大安門，不克，奔于隴州。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu he attacked the Great Peace Gate but could not take it and fled to Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he attacked the Great Peace Gate but could not take it and fled to Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，武定軍節度使李茂貞為隴州招討使。

translations.literal: On the day renzi Wuding military commissioner Li Maozhen was made Longzhou suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Wuding military commissioner Li Maozhen was made Longzhou suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，護國軍將常行儒殺其節度使王重榮，其兄重盈自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi Huguo army general Chang Xingru killed its military commissioner Wang Chongrong; his elder brother Chongying declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Huguo army general Chang Xingru killed its military commissioner Wang Chongrong, and his elder brother Chongying declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，亳州將謝殷逐其刺史宋衮。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Bozhou general Xie Yin expelled its prefect Song Gun.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Bozhou general Xie Yin expelled its prefect Song Gun.

sentences.zh: 七月丁亥，降死罪以下，貞觀、開元、建中、興元功臣後予一子九品正員官，減常膳三之一，賜民九十以上粟帛。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day dinghai capital punishment and below was reduced; descendants of Zhenguan, Kaiyuan, Jianzhong, and Xingyuan meritorious subjects were granted one son a ninth-rank regular official post; regular meals were reduced by one-third; the people aged ninety and above were granted grain and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on dinghai capital punishment and below was reduced; descendants of Zhenguan, Kaiyuan, Jianzhong, and Xingyuan meritorious subjects were granted one son a ninth-rank regular official post; regular meals were reduced by one-third; and people aged ninety and above were granted grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 七月，李昌符伏誅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Li Changfu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: That year, eventh month Li Changfu was executed.

sentences.zh: 八月，韋昭度為太保。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Wei Zhaodu was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: That year, ighth month Wei Zhaodu was made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，謝殷伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Xie Yin was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Xie Yin was executed.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠陷亳州。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong captured Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong took Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，陷曹州，刺史丘弘禮死之。

translations.literal: On the day renzi he captured Caozhou and prefect Qiu Hongli died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he captured Caozhou and prefect Qiu Hongli was killed.

sentences.zh: 九月，戶部侍郎、判度支張濬為兵部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Minister of Revenue and acting finance commissioner Zhang Jun was made Minister of War and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Minister of Revenue and acting finance commissioner Zhang Jun was appointed Minister of War and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 秦彥殺高駢。

translations.literal: Qin Yan killed Gao Pian.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Yan killed Gao Pian.

sentences.zh: 十月丁未，朱全忠陷濮州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day dingwei Zhu Quanzhong captured Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on dingwei Zhu Quanzhong captured Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，封子陞為益王。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin his son Sheng was enfeoffed as Prince of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin his son Sheng was enfeoffed as Prince of Yi.

sentences.zh: 杭州刺史錢鏐陷常州。

translations.literal: Hangzhou prefect Qian Liu captured Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou prefect Qian Liu took Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，鏐殺周寶。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Liu killed Zhou Bao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Liu killed Zhou Bao.

sentences.zh: 是月，秦宗權將孫儒寇揚州。

translations.literal: That month Qin Zongquan's general Sun Ru raided Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qin Zongquan's general Sun Ru raided Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，廬州刺史楊行密陷揚州，秦彥、畢師鐸奔于孫儒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day renshen Luzhou prefect Yang Xingmi captured Yangzhou; Qin Yan and Bi Shiduo fled to Sun Ru.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renshen Luzhou prefect Yang Xingmi captured Yangzhou, and Qin Yan and Bi Shiduo fled to Sun Ru.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，淮西將趙德諲陷江陵，荊南節度使張瓌死之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day guisi the Huaixi general Zhao Dexun captured Jiangling and Jingnan military commissioner Zhang Gui died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on guisi the Huaixi general Zhao Dexun captured Jiangling and Jingnan military commissioner Zhang Gui was killed.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠為東南面招討使。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong was made southeastern suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong was made southeastern suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 饒州刺史陳儒陷衢州。

translations.literal: Raozhou prefect Chen Ru captured Quzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Raozhou prefect Chen Ru took Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 上蔡賊馮敬章陷蘄州。

translations.literal: The Shangcai bandit Feng Jingzhang captured Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Shangcai bandit Feng Jingzhang took Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 文德元年正月甲寅，孫儒殺秦彥、畢師鐸。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wende in the first month on the day jiayin Sun Ru killed Qin Yan and Bi Shiduo.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wende in the first month on jiayin Sun Ru killed Qin Yan and Bi Shiduo.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，朱全忠為蔡州四面行營都統。

translations.literal: On the day haihai Zhu Quanzhong was made overall commander of the four sides of Caizhou campaign troops.
translations.idiomatic: On haihai Zhu Quanzhong was made overall commander of the four sides of Caizhou campaign troops.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，薛朗伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin Xue Lang was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Xue Lang was executed.

sentences.zh: 錢鏐陷潤州。

translations.literal: Qian Liu captured Runzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liu took Runzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，不豫。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day yihai he was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on yihai he fell ill.

sentences.zh: 己丑，至自鳳翔。

translations.literal: On the day jichou he returned from Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he returned from Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，謁于太廟，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin he visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the reign title.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 是月，魏博軍亂，殺其節度使樂彥禎，其將羅弘信自稱權知留後。

translations.literal: That month the Weibo army mutinied and killed its military commissioner Yue Yanzhen; his general Luo Hongxin declared himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Weibo army mutinied and killed its military commissioner Yue Yanzhen, and his general Luo Hongxin declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌朔，日有食之，既。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, wuxu, there was a total solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, wuxu, there was a total solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，疾大漸，立壽王傑為皇太弟，知軍國事。

translations.literal: On the day renyin his illness became grave; Prince of Shou Jie was established as imperial younger brother and charged with state and military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin his illness became critical; Prince of Shou Jie was established as imperial younger brother and charged with state and military affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，皇帝崩于武德殿，年二十七。

translations.literal: On the day guimao the emperor died in the Hall of Martial Virtue at age twenty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the emperor died in the Hall of Martial Virtue at the age of twenty-seven.

sentences.zh: 【贊】贊曰：唐自穆宗以來八世，而為宦官所立者七君。

translations.literal: 【Appraisal】The appraisal says: From Muzong onward for eight generations of Tang, seven rulers were installed by eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: 【Appraisal】The appraisal says: From Muzong onward for eight generations of Tang, seven rulers were installed by eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 然則唐之衰亡，豈止方鎮之患？

translations.literal: Yet then the decline and fall of Tang—was it only the affliction of the frontier commands?
translations.idiomatic: Yet then the decline and fall of Tang—was it only the affliction of the frontier commands?

sentences.zh: 蓋朝廷天下之本也，人君者朝廷之本也，始即位者人君之本也。

translations.literal: The court is the root of the realm, the ruler is the root of the court, and the one who first takes the throne is the root of the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The court is the root of the realm, the ruler is the root of the court, and the one who first takes the throne is the root of the ruler.

sentences.zh: 其本始不正，欲以正天下，其可得乎？

translations.literal: If the root from the beginning is not correct, wishing to set the realm right—how can that be obtained?
translations.idiomatic: If the root from the beginning is not correct, how can one set the realm right?

sentences.zh: 懿、僖當唐政之始衰，而以昏庸相繼；

translations.literal: Yizong and Xizong stood at the beginning of Tang's political decline, and muddled rulers succeeded one another in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Yizong and Xizong stood at the beginning of Tang's political decline, and muddled rulers succeeded one another in turn.

sentences.zh: 乾符之際，歲大旱蝗，民愁盜起，其亂遂不可復支，蓋亦天人之會歟！

translations.literal: At the time of Qianfu, great drought and locusts came year after year; the people were distressed and bandits arose, and the disorder then could no longer be sustained—was it perhaps also a convergence of heaven and man!
translations.idiomatic: At the time of Qianfu, great drought and locusts came year after year; the people were distressed and bandits arose, and the disorder then could no longer be sustained—was it perhaps also a convergence of heaven and man!
